G2300.def:
θεάομαι, -ῶμαι
[in LXX; 2Cr 22:6 (רָאָה), Tob.2:2 13:6, 14, Jdth.15:8, 2Ma.2:4 2Mac 3:36, 3Ma.5:47 * ;]
to behold, look upon, contemplate, view (in early writers with a sense of wondering), in NT apparently always in literal, physical sense of "careful and deliberate vision which interprets . . . its object": with accusative of thing(s), Mt 11:7, Lc 7:24 23:55, Jo 1:14, 32 4:35 11:45, At 22:9, 1Jo 1:1; with accusative of person(s), Mt 22:11, At 21:27, Rm 15:24, 1Jo 4:12; with ptcp., Mc 16:14, Lc 5:27, Jo 1:38, At 1:11; before ὅτι, Jo 6:5, 1Jo 4:14; pass., Mt 6:1 23:5, Mc 16:11.†
SYN.: see: θεωρέω (AS)

G2301.def:
θεατρίζω
(θέατρον),
to make a spectacle of, expose to contempt (eccl.; ἐκθ-, Polyb.): pass., Hb 10:33.†
(AS)

G2302.def:
θέατρον, -ον, τό
(θεάομαι),
__1. a theatre (used also as a place of assembly): At 19:29, 31.
__2. Collective for οἱ θεαταί, the spectators.
__3. = θέα, θέαμα, a spectacle, show: metaphorically, 1Co 4:9.†
(AS)

G2304.def:
θεῖος, -εία, -εῖον
(θεός), [in LXX: Êx 31:3 35:31, Jó 27:3 33:4, Pv 2:17 (אֵל, אֱלֹהִים, אֱלוֹהַּ), Sir.6:35, 1-37 II Ml 3:1-40, 3Ma.1:1-29, 4Mac.25 * ;]
divine: δύναμις, 2Pe 1:3; φύσις (for parallel in π., see MM, Exp., xv), 2Pe 1:4; τὸ θ.,
the Deity (so in cl.; of God, in Philo and FlJ), At 17:29.†
(AS)

G2305.def:
θειότης, -ητος, ἡ
(θεῖος) [in LXX: Wis.18:9 * ;]
divine nature, divinity: Rm 1:20 (for ex. from π., see MM, Exp., xv).†
SYN.: θεότης, deity, godhead, divine personality. θει. = divine nature and properties, a summary term for the attributes of deity, differing from θεότης as quality or attribute from essence (AS)

G2307.def:
θέλημα, -τος, τό
(θέλω), [in LXX chiefly for חָפֵץ, also for רָצוֹן, etc. ;]
will,
__(a) objectively = that which is willed: Mt 18:14, Lc 12:47, Jo 5:30, 1Co 7:37, 1Ts 5:18, 2Tm 2:26, Hb 10:10, Ap 4:11; θ. τ. θεοῦ, At 22:14, Rm 2:18 12:2, Ef 1:9, Cl 1:9 4:12, 1Pe 4:2; τ. κυρίου, Ef 5:17; pl., of precepts, Mc 3:35, WH, mg., At 13:22 (LXX); ἐστιν τὸ θ., with genitive of person(s), before ἵνα, Jo 6:39-40, 1Co 16:12; with inf., 1Pe 2:15; with accusative and inf., 1Ts 4:3
__(b) subjectively = τὸ θέλειν (cf. θέλησις): Lc 23:25, Jo 1:13, 1Pe 3:17, 2Pe 1:21; ποιεῖν, Mt 7:21 12:50 21:31, Mc 3:35 (pl., WH, mg., see supr.), Jo 4:34 6:38 7:17 9:31, Ef 6:6, Hb 10:7, 9 10:36 13:21, 1Jo 2:17; γίνεσθαι, Mt 6:10 26:42, Lc 22:42, At 21:14; ἡ εὐδοκία ( βουλὴ) τοῦ θ., Ef 1:5, 11; ἐν τῷ θ. τοῦ θεοῦ, Rm 1:10; διὰ θ. θεοῦ, Rm 15:32, 1Co 1:1, 2Co 1:1 8:5, Ef 1:1, Cl 1:1, 2Tm 1:1; κατὰ τὸ θ. τ. θεοῦ, Gl 1:4, 1Pe 4:19, 1Jo 5:14; pl., Ef 2:3 (Cremer, 728).†
(AS)

G2308.def:
θέλησις, -εως, ἡ
(θέλω) [in LXX: 2Cr 15:15, Pv 8:35 (רָצוֹן), Eze.18:23 (חֵפֶץ), LXX Dn 11:45 (צְבִי), Tob.12:18, Wis.16:25, 2Ma.12:16, 3Ma.2:26 * ;]
in colloq. and MGr. = τὸ θέλειν,
will: Hb 2:4.†
(AS)

G2309.def:
θέλω (the strengthened form ἐθέλω is found in Hom., and is the more frequently in Attic; see Rutherford, NPhr., 415f.),
[in LXX for חפץ ,אבה; with neg., מאן pi., etc. ;]
to will, be willing, wish, desire (more frequently than βούλομαι, which see, in vernac. and late Gk., also in MGr.; for various views as to its relation to β., see Thayer, 286; but see also BL, §24, see word): absol., Rm 9:16, 1Co 4:19 12:18, Tg 4:15; τ. θεοῦ θέλοντος, At 18:21; with accusative of thing(s), Mt 20:21, Mc 14:36, Jo 15:7, Rm 7:15, 16 1Co 4:21 7:36, Gl 5:17; with inf., Mt 5:40, Mc 10:43, Jo 6:21, 67 Rm 7:21, Gl 4:9; with accusative and inf., Mc 7:24, Lc 1:62, Jo 21:22, 23 Rm 16:19, 1Co 14:5, Gl 6:13; οὐ θέλω, Mt 18:30, al.; id. with inf., Mt 2:18, Mc 6:26, Jo 5:40, 1Co 16:7; before ἵνα, Mt 7:12, Mc 6:25, Jo 17:24; opposite to ποιέω, πράσσω, ἐνεργέω, Rm 7:15, 19 2Co 8:10, 11 Fp 2:13; before ἤ (ICG, in l.; Deiss., LAE, 179:24), 1Co 14:19; θέλων ἐν ταπεινοφροσυνῄ (of his own mere will, by humility, R, mg), Cl 2:18; in OT quotations, for Heb. חפץ, with accusative of person(s), Mt 27:43; with accusative of thing(s), Mt 9:13 12:7, Hb 10:5, 8; with inf., 1Pe 3:10; for אמר, with inf., At 7:28 (see Cremer, 726ff.).
θέλω (the strengthened form ἐθέλω is found in Hom., and is the more frequently in Attic; see Rutherford, NPhr., 415f.),
[in LXX for חפץ ,אבה; with neg., מאן pi., etc. ;]
to will, be willing, wish, desire (more frequently than βούλομαι, which see, in vernac. and late Gk., also in MGr.; for various views as to its relation to β., see Thayer, 286; but see also BL, §24, see word): absol., Rm 9:16, 1Co 4:19 12:18, Tg 4:15; τ. θεοῦ θέλοντος, At 18:21; with accusative of thing(s), Mt 20:21, Mc 14:36, Jo 15:7, Rm 7:15, 16 1Co 4:21 7:36, Gl 5:17; with inf., Mt 5:40, Mc 10:43, Jo 6:21, 67 Rm 7:21, Gl 4:9; with accusative and inf., Mc 7:24, Lc 1:62, Jo 21:22, 23 Rm 16:19, 1Co 14:5, Gl 6:13; οὐ θέλω, Mt 18:30, al.; id. with inf., Mt 2:18, Mc 6:26, Jo 5:40, 1Co 16:7; before ἵνα, Mt 7:12, Mc 6:25, Jo 17:24; opposite to ποιέω, πράσσω, ἐνεργέω, Rm 7:15, 19 2Co 8:10, 11 Fp 2:13; before ἤ (ICG, in l.; Deiss., LAE, 179:24), 1Co 14:19; θέλων ἐν ταπεινοφροσυνῄ (of his own mere will, by humility, R, mg), Cl 2:18; in OT quotations, for Heb. חפץ, with accusative of person(s), Mt 27:43; with accusative of thing(s), Mt 9:13 12:7, Hb 10:5, 8; with inf., 1Pe 3:10; for אמר, with inf., At 7:28 (see Cremer, 726ff.).
(AS)

G2310.def:
θεμέλιος, -ον
(τίθημι), [in LXX for אַרְמוֹן, מוֹסָד, etc. ;]
of or for a foundation; as subst., ὁ θ. (sc. λίθος), a foundation stone, foundation: Lc 6:48-49 14:29 (but see Deiss., BS, 123); pl., οἰ θ. (cl.), Hb 11:10 Ap 21:14, 19; neut., τὸ θ. (Arist., Phys., vi, 6, 10, LXX and later writers), At 16:26; metaphorically, Rm 15:20, 1Co 3:10-12 Ef 2:20, 1Tm 6:19, 2Tm 2:19, Hb 6:1.†
(AS)

G2311.def:
θεμελιόω, -ῶ
[in LXX chiefly for יָסַד ;]
to lay the foundation of, to found: with accusative, τ. γῆν, Hb 1:10 (LXX); pass., Mt 7:25, Lc 6:48; metaphorically, 1Pe 5:10 (R, mg., settle); pass., Ef 3:18, Cl 1:23.†
(AS)

G2312.def:
θεο-δίδακτος, -ον
taught of God (cf. διδακτοὶ θεοῦ, Jo 6:45): 1Ts 4:9.†
(AS)

G2314.def:
θεομάχος, -ον
[in Sm.: Jó 26:5, Pv 9:18 21:16 * ;]
fighting against God: At 5:39.†
(AS)

G2316.def:
θεός, -οῦ, ὁ, ἡ (At 19:37 only; see M, Pr., 60, 244), late voc., θεέ (Mt 27:46; cf. Dt 3:24, al.),
[in LXX chiefly for אֱלֹהִים, also for אֵל and other cognate forms, יהוה, etc. ;]
a god or deity, God.
__1. In polytheistic sense, a god or deity: At 28:6, 1Co 8:4, 2Ts 2:4, al.; pl., Ac. 14:11 19:26, Gl 4:8, al.
__2. Of the one true God;
__(a) anarthrous: Mt 6:24, Lc 20:38, al.; esp. with prep. (Kühner 3, iii, 605), ἀπὸ θ., Jo 3:2; ἐκ, At 5:39, 2Co 5:1, Fp 3:9; ὑπό, Rm 13:1; παρὰ θεοῦ, Jo 1:6; παρὰ θεῷ, 2Ts 1:6, 1Pe 2:4; κατὰ θεόν, Rm 8:27, 2Co 7:9, 10; also when in genitive dependent on an anarth. noun (Bl., §46, 6), Mt 27:43, Lc 3:2, Rm 1:17, 1Ts 2:13; as pred., Lk 20:38, Jo 1:1, and when the nature and character rather than the person of God is meant, At 5:29, Gl 2:6, al. (M, Th., 14);
__(b) more freq., with art.: Mt 1:23, Mc 2:7, al. mult.; with prep., ἀπὸ τ. θ., Lc 1:26; ἐκ, Jo 8:42, al.; παρὰ τοῦ θ., Jo 8:40; π. τῷ θ., Rm 9:14; ἐν, Cl 3:3; ἐπὶ τῷ θ., Lc 1:47; ἐπὶ τὸν θ., At 15:19; εἰς τ. θ., At 24:15; πρὸς τ. θ., Jo 1:2; with genitive of person(s), Mt 22:32, Mc 12:26, 27, Lc 20:37, Jo 20:17, al.; ὁ θ. μου, Rm 1:8, Php 1:3, al.; ὁ θ. καὶ πατήρ κ. τ. λ., Rm 15:6, Ef 1:3, Phi 4:20, al.; with genitive of thing(s), Rm 15:5, 13, 33, 2Co 1:3, 1Ts 5:23; τὰ τ. θεοῦ, Mt 16:23, Mc 12:17, 1Co 2:11; τὰ πρὸς τὸν θ., Rm 15:17, Hb 2:17 5:1; τ. θεῷ, as a superl. (LXX, Js 3:3), At 7:20, 2Co 10:4; Hebraistically, of judges (Psa.81(82):6), Jo 10:34" (LXX), 35.
(AS)

G2317.def:
θεοσέβεια, -ας, ἡ
(θεοσεβής), [in LXX Gn 20:11 (אֱלֹהִים יִרְאָה), Jó 28:28 (אֲדֹנָי id.), Sir.1:24, Bar.5:4, 4Ma.7:6 4Mac 7:22, א 4Ma.15:28 א 4Ma.17:15 * ;]
fear of God, godliness: 1Tm 2:10.†
(AS)

G2318.def:
θεοσεβής, -ές
(θεός, σέβομαι), [in LXX for אֱלֹהִים יָרֵא, Êx 18:21, al. ;]
God-fearing, godly: Jo 9:31.†
SYN.: εὐσεβής (which see), θρῆσκος (AS)

G2319.def:
θεοστυγής, -ές
(θεός, στυγέω),
__1. passive, as frequently in cl., hateful to God: Rm 1:30 (R, txt., cf. Lit., Notes, 256).
__2. Active, hating God: lb. (R, mg., cf. ICC, in l).†
(AS)

G2322.def:
θεραπεία, -ας, ἡ
(θεραπεύω) [in LXX for עֶבֶד Gn 45:16 (cf. Et 5:2), etc. ;]
__1. service.
__2. healing: Lc 9:11 (Field, Notes, 60), Ap 22:2.
__3. Collective, household attendants, servants: Lc 12:42 (LXX, ll. with).†
(AS)

G2323.def:
θεραπεύω
[in LXX for יָשַׁב, etc. ;]
__1. to do service, serve: with accusative of person(s), pass., At 17:25.
__2. As medical term, to treat (MM, Exp., xv), cure, heal: Mt 12:10, Mc 6:5, Lc 6:7, al.; with accusative of person(s), Mt 4:24, Mc 1:34, al.; before ἀπό, Lc 5:15 6:18 7:21 8:2, 43; θ. νόσον (μαλακίαν), Mt 4:23, al
SYN: ἰάομαι (see Field, Notes, 60; MM, Exp., l.with)
(AS)

G2324.def:
θεράπων, -οντος, ὁ
[in LXX chiefly for עֶבֶד ;]
an attendant, servant: Hb 3:5 (LXX)
SYN.: see: διάκονος (AS)

G2325.def:
θερίζω
(θέρος), [in LXX chiefly for קָצַר ;]
to reap: Mt 6:26, Lc 12:24, Tg 5:4; figuratively, Mt 25:24, 26, Lc 19:21-22, Jo 4:36-38, 2Co 9:6, Gl 6:7, 9, Ap 14:15; with accusative, τ. σαρκικά, 1Co 9:11; φθοράν, ζωὴν αἰώνιον, Gl 6:8; τ. γῆν, Ap 14:16.†
(AS)

G2326.def:
θερισμός, -οῦ, ὁ
(θερίζω), [in LXX chiefly for קָצִיר ;]
harvest;
__(a) the act: Jo 4:35;
__(b) the time: fig., Mt 13:30, 39, Mc 4:29
__(with) the crop: figuratively, Mt 9:37-38, Lc 10:2, Ap 14:15.†
(AS)

G2327.def:
θεριστής, -οῦ, ὁ
(θερίζω), [in LXX: Dan LXX Bel 1:32, Th Bel 1:33* ;]
a reaper: Mt 13:30, 39†
(AS)

G2328.def:
θερμαίνω
(θερμός), [in LXX chiefly for חָמַם ;]
to warm, heat; mid., to warm oneself: Mc 14:54, 67, Jo 18:18, 25 Tg 2:16.†
(AS)

G2329.def:
θέρμη, -ης, ἡ
[in LXX: Jó 6:17, Sl 19:6, Ec 4:11 (חָמַם and derivatives), Sir.38:28 * ;]
heat: At 28:3.†
(AS)

G2330.def:
θέρος, -ους, τό
(θέρω, to heat), [in LXX chiefly for קַיִץ ;]
summer: Mt 24:32, Mc 13:28, Lc 21:30.†
(AS)

G2332.def:
θεσσαλονίκη, -ης, ἡ
Thessalonica, a city of Macedonia: At 17:1, 11 17:13, Fp 4:16, 2Tm 4:10.†
(AS)

G2333.def:
Θευδᾶς
(perh. contr. from Θεόδωρος, but see MM, Exp., xv), -ᾶ, ὁ
Theudas: At 5:36.†
(AS)

G2334.def:
θεωρέω, -ῶ
(θεωρός, a spectator, θεάομαι) [in LXX chiefly for רָאָה, חָזָה ;] (present and imperfect only, exc. Jo 7:3 (fut.), Mt 28:1, Lc 23:48, Jo 8:51, Ap 11:12 (aor.); El., § 24);
__1. (cl.), to look at, gaze, behold: absol., Mt 27:55, Mc 15:40, Lc 23:35; before πῶς, Mc 12:41; ποῦ, Mc 15:47; with accusative of person(s), Jo 6:40, 62 12:45 16:10-19, At 3:16 20:38 25:24, Ap 11:11-12; id. with ptcp., Mc 5:15, Lc 10:18, Jo 6:19 10:12 20:12, 14, 1Jo 3:17; with accusative of thing(s), Mt 28:1, Lc 14:29 21:6 23:48, Jo 2:23 6:2 7:3, At 4:13 8:13; id. with ptcp., Jo 20:6, At 7:56 10:11; before ὅτι, At 19:26.
__2. In popular lang. (Kennedy, Sources, 155; EL, § 24, see word ὁρᾶν), in present and imperfect = ὁράω, to see, perceive, discern: before ὅτι, Mc 16:4, Jo 4:19 12:19, At 19:26 27:10; πόσαι, At 21:20; πηλίκος, Hb 7:4; with accusative of thing(s), Mc 5:38; id. with ptcp., At 17:16 28:6; with accusative of person(s), Mc 3:11, Jo 14:19, At 9:7 17:22; πνεῦμα, Lc 24:37; τὸ π., Jo 14:17; before ὅτι, Jo 9:8; with ptcp., Lc 24:39.
__3. Hebraistically, to experience, partake of: τ. θάνατον, Jo 8:51 (cf. Sl 89:49); τ. δόξαν, Jo 17:24 (cf. ἀνα-, παρα-θερρέω).†
(AS)

G2335.def:
θεωρία, -ας, ἡ
(see: θεωρέω), [in LXX: Dan LXX 5:7, 2Ma.5:26 2Mac 15:12, 3Ma.5:24 * ;]
__1. a viewing.
__2. = θεώρημα, a spectacle, sight: Lc 23:48 (both senses in cl.).†
(AS)

G2336.def:
Θήκη, -ης, ἡ
(τίθημι), [in LXX: Êx 25:27 (בַּיִת), Is 6:13 3:26 * ;]
a receptacle, chest, case: of the sheath of a sword, Jo 18:11.†
(AS)

G2337.def:
θηλάζω
(θηλή, a breast), [in LXX chiefly for יָנַק hi. ;]
__1. of the mother, to suckle: Mt 24:19, Mc 13:17, Lc 21:23.
__2. Of the young, to suck: Mt 21:16; μαστούς, Lc 11:27 (cf. Jó 3:12, Ct 8:1, al.).†
(AS)

G2338.def:
θῆλυς, -εια, -υ
[in LXX chiefly for נְקֵבָה ;]
female: as subst., ἡ θ., a female, a woman: Rm 1:26-27; τὸ θ.., Mt 19:4, Mc 10:6, Gl 3:28.†
(AS)

G2339.def:
θήρα, -ας, ἡ
[in LXX for צַיִד, טָרַף, רֶשֶׁת, and cogn. forms ;]
__1. a hunting, chase (Hat., Xen., al.).
__2. prey, game (c1.).
__3. As in Sl 35:8 = רֶשֶׁת, a net: Rm 11:9 (but see Thayer, see word).†
(AS)

G2340.def:
θηρεύω
(θήρα), [in LXX for צוּד, etc. ;]
to hunt, ensnare, catch: metaphorically, Lc 11:54.†
(AS)

G2341.def:
θηριομαχέω, -ῶ
(θηρίον, μάχομαι),
to fight with wild beasts (Diod., al.): 1Co 15:32.†
(AS)

G2342.def:
θηρίον, -ου, τό
(dimin. of θήρ), [in LXX chiefly for חַי ;]
a wild beast, beast: Mc 1:13, At 11:6 28:4-5, Tt 1:12, Hb 12:20, Tg 3:7, Ap 6:8; of Antichrist, Ap 11:7, 13-19.†
(AS)

G2343.def:
θησαυρίζω
[in LXX for צָפַן, etc. ;]
to lay up, store up: of riches, Tg 5:3; id. with dative of person(s), Lc 12:21, 2Co 12:14; with accusative of thing(s), 1Co 16:2; θησαυροὺς ἑαυτῷ, Mt 6:19-20; pass., 2Pe 3:7; metaphorically, ὀργὴν ἑαντῷ, Rm 2:5 (cf. Pv 1:18, Pss. Pss.Sol 9:9).†
(AS)

G2344.def:
θησαυρός, -οῦ, ὁ
(τίθημι), [in LXX chiefly for אוֹצָר ;]
__1. a place of safe keeping;
__(a) a casket: Mt 2:11;
__(b) a treasury (1Ma.3:29 and frequently in cl.);
__(with) a storehouse (Ne 13:12, Dt 28:12, al.): Mt 13:52; metaphorically, of the soul, Mt 12:35; τ. καρδίας, Lc 6:45
__2. a treasure: Mt 6:18-21 13:44, Lc 12:33-34, Hb 11:26; θ. ἐν οὐρανῷ (see Dalman, Words, 206 ff.), Mt 19:21, Mc 10:21, Lc 18:22; of the knowledge of God through Christ, 2Co 4:7; τ. σοφίας κ. γνώσεως, Cl 2:3.†
(AS)

G2345.def:
θιγγάνω
[in LXX for נָגַע, Êx 19:12 * ;]
__1. to touch, handle: Cl 2:21, Hb 12:20" (LXX) .
__2. to injure (like Heb. נָגַע, and as in Eur., Iph. Aul., 1351): with genitive, Hb 11:28.†
SYN.: see: ἅπτω (AS)

G2346.def:
θλίβω
[in LXX chiefly (ὁ θλίβων, ) for צוּר ;]
to press: with accusative of person(s), Mc 3:9; ὁδὸς τεθλιμμένη, a narrow (compressed) way, Mt 7:14. Metaphorical (as frequently in LXX), to oppress, afflict, distress: with accusative of person(s), 2Ts 1:6; pass. (Vg., tribulor, tribulation em patior), 2Co 1:6 4:8 7:5, 1Ts 3:4, 2Ts 1:7, 1Tm 5:10, Hb 11:37 (cf. ἀπο-, συν-θλίβω).†
(AS)

G2347.def:
θλίψις (LTr., θλῖψις), -εως, ἡ
(θλίβω), [in LXX for צָרָה, etc. ;]
pressure (Arist.). In LXX and NT metaphorically, tribulation, affliction, distress: Mt 24:9, 21 24:29, Mc 13:19, 24, Jo 16:21, At 7:11 11:19, Rm 12:12, 2Co 1:4 1:8 4:17 6:4 7:4 8:2 8:13, Fp 4:14, 2Ts 1:6, Tg 1:27, Ap 1:9 2:9, 22 7:14; with ἀνάγκη (which see), 1Ts 3:7; στενοχωρία (which from the order of the words would appear to be the stronger term), Rm 2:9 8:35; διωγμός, Mt 13:21, Mc 4:17, 2Ts 1:4; θ. ἔχω, Jo 16:33, 1Co 7:23, Ap 2:10; ἔρχεσθαι ἐπί, At 7:11; ἐν θλίψει 1Ts 1:6; pl., At 7:10 14:22 20:28, Rm 5:3, Ef 3:13, 1Ts 3:3, Hb 10:33; τ. Χριστοῦ, Cl 1:24; θ. τῆς καρδίας, 2Co 2:4; θ. ἐγείρειν, Fp 1:17.†
SYN.: ἀνάγκη, διωγμός, στενοχωρία (see supr., and cf. Tr., Syn, iv; Lft., Notes, 45) (AS)

G2348.def:
θνήσκω
[in LXX chiefly for מוּת ;]
to die; pf. (M, Pr., 114), to be dead: Mt 2:20, Mc 15:44, Lc 7:12 8:49, Jo 11:44 19:33, At 14:19 25:19; metaphorically, of spiritual death, 1Tm 5:6 (cf. ἀπο-, συν-απο-θνήσκω).†
(AS)

G2349.def:
θνητός, -ή, -όν
(θνήσκω), [in LXX: Pv 3:13 20:24 (אָדָם), Jó 30:23 (חַי), Is 51:12 (מוּת), Wis.9:14 15:17, 2Ma.9:12, 3Ma.3:29 * ;]
subject to death, mortal: Rm 6:12 8:11, 1Co 15:53-54, 2Co 4:11 5:4.†
(AS)

G2350.def:
θορυβέω, -ῶ
(θόρυβος), [in LXX: Na 2:3 (רָעַל ho.), Dan LXX 8:17 (בָּעַת ni.), Jz 3:26, Wis.18:19, Sir.40:6 * ;]
__1. to make a noise or uproar: mid., of loud and ostentatious lamentation, Mt 9:23, Mc 5:39, At 20:10.
__2. Trans., to trouble, throw into confusion: τ. πόλιν, At 17:5.†
(AS)

G2351.def:
θόρυβος, -ου, ὁ
[in LXX for הָמוֹן, etc. ;]
a noise, uproar, tumult, as of an excited mob: Mt 26:5 27:24, Mc 14:2, At 20:1 21:34 24:18; of mourners, = ὄχλος θορυβούμενος, Mc 5:38.†
(AS)

G2352.def:
θραύω
[in LXX for 1,21 (Dt 28:33, Is 42:4 58:6), etc. ;]
to break in pieces, shatter; metaphorically, to break down: Lc 4:18 (LXX).†
(AS)

G2353.def:
θρέμμα, -τος, τό
(τρέφω)
__1. a nurseling, esp. of animals (Eur., Plat., al.).
__2. cattle: Jo 4:12.†
(AS)

G2354.def:
θρηνέω, -ῶ
(θρῆνος), [in LXX chiefly for יָלַל hi., also for קַיִן pit., etc. ;]
__1. intrans., to lament, wail: Mt 11:17, Lc 7:32, Jo 16:20.
__2. Trans., to bewail: with accusative of person(s), Lc 23:27.†
SYN.: κλαίω, κόπτομαι, λυπέομαι, πενθέω (see Tr., Syn., lxv). (AS)

G2355.def:
θρῆνος, -ου, ὁ
[in LXX chiefly for קִינָה ;]
a lamentation: Mt 2:18, Rec.†
(AS)

G2356.def:
θρησκεία (-κία, T), -ας, ἡ
(θρῆσκος), [in LXX: Wis.14:18, 27, Sir.22:5 A, 4Ma.5:6 4Mac 5:13 * ;]
religion in its external aspect (MM, Exp., xv), worship: At 26:5, Tg 1:26-27; θ. τῶν ἀγγέλων, Cl 2:18.†
SYN.: see: θρῆσκος (AS)

G2357.def:
θρῆσκος
(-κός, WH), -ον, ό
religious, careful of the outward forms of divine service (see previous word)): Tg 1:26.†
SYN.: εὐσεβής, θεοσεβής, δεισιδαίμων (see Tr., Syn., § xlviii) (AS)

G2358.def:
θριαμβεύω
(θρίαμβος, 1. a festal hymn to Bacchus. 2. The Roman triumphus),
__1. to triumph (and rarely, with accusative, to triumph over; so perh. Cl 2:15, but see infr.).
__2. to lead in triumph: with accusative of person(s), 2Co 2:14; hence, generally, to make a spectacle or show of: Cl 2:15 (but see supr.; cf. MM, Exp., xv; and esp. Field, Notes, 181).†
(AS)

G2359.def:
θρίξ, τριχός, ἡ
[in LXX chiefly for שֵׂעָר ;]
hair;
__(a) of the head: Mt 3:4 5:36 10:30, Lc 7:38, 44 12:7 21:18, Jo 11:2 12:3, At 27:34, 1Pe 3:3, Ap 1:14;
__(b) of animals: Mc 1:6, Ap 9:8.†
(AS)

G2360.def:
θροέω, -ῶ
(θρόος, a noise, tumult), [in LXX: Ct 5:4 (הָמָה * ;]
in cl.,
__1. to cry aloud, make an outcry.
__2. to utter aloud.
__3. In NT (and LXX), pass., to be troubled, as by an alarm: Mt 24:6, Mc 13:7, Lc 24:37 (WH, mg.), 2Ts 2:2 (cf. Kennedy, Sources, 126).†
(AS)

G2361.def:
θρόμβος, -ου, ὁ
(τρέφω, in primary sense to thicken),
a lump, a clot of blood (DCG, ii, 685b): αἵματος, Lc 22:44 (WH, R, mg. omit the passage, see WH, App., 64 ff.).†
(AS)

G2362.def:
θρόνος, -ου, ὁ
[in LXX chiefly for כִּסֵּא, Êx 11:5, al. ;]
in Hom., a seat, chair. Later, a throne, chair of state, seat of authority; of kings: metaphorically, of God, Mt 5:34, At 7:49" (LXX), Ap 1:4, al.; by meton., for kingly power, sovereignty, Lc 1:32, 52, At 2:30; for an angelic hierarchy, Cl 1:16; of Christ, Mt 19:28, Ap 3:21, al.; of Satan, Ap 2:13; τ. θηρίου, Ap 16:10; of the Apostles, Mt 19:28, Lc 22:30, cf. Ap 20:4; of πρεσβύτεροι, Ap 4:4 11:16 (on θ. τῆς χάριτος, Hb 4:16, see Westc., in l; Deiss., BS, 135)
(AS)

G2363.def:
Θυάτειρα, -ων, τά
(-ας, ἡ, Ap 1:11 L; cf. WH, App., 156)
Thyatira, a city of Lydia: At 16:14, Ap 1:11 2:18, 24.†
(AS)

G2364.def:
θυγάτηρ, -τρός, ἡ
(for use of vocat., cf. M, Pr., 71; WH, App, 158), [in LXX for בַּת (Gn 5:4, al.), exc. Jz 21:14 B, 2Cr 21:17 (אִשָּׁה ;]
daughter: Mt 9:18 10:35, 37 14:6 15:22, 28, Mc 5:35 6:22 7:26, 29, Lc 2:36 8:42, 49 12:53, At 2:17" (LXX) At 7:21 21:9, Hb 11:24. In NT, as in OT, not in cl.;
__(a) as a form of friendly address (cf. Rt 2:2, 22 al.): Mt 9:22, Mc 5:34, Lc 8:48;
__(b) metaphorically: sc. κυρίου, 2Co 6:18 (cf. Is 43:6);
__(with) of posterity: θ. Ἀαρών, Lc 1:5; Ἀβραάμ, Lc 13:16 (cf. Is 16:2, 4Ma.15:28, al);
__(d) of habita­tion: θ. Σιών, Ἱερουσαλήμ, Mt 21:5 (LXX), Lc 23:28, Jo 12:15 (cf. Is 1:8, Zc 9:9, al.).†
(AS)

G2365.def:
θυγάτριον, -ου, τό
(dimin. of θυγάτηρ),
a little daughter, a term of endearment used in late Gk. (cf. B1., § 27, 4): Mc 5:23 7:25.†
(AS)

G2366.def:
θύελλα, -ης, ἡ
(θύω), [in LXX Dt 4:11 5:22 (עֲרָפֶל), Êx 10:22 * ;] (poët. in cl.),
a hurricane, cyclone, whirlwind: Hb 12:18.†
SYN.: λαίλαψ (which see) (AS)

G2367.def:
θύινος (usually θύϊνος, as Rec.), -η, -ον
(θυία, θύα, an African aromatic tree, with ornamentally veined wood of varying colour, = Lat. citrinus), [in Sm.: 3Ki.10:11 (אַלְמֻגִּים)* ;]
thyme: ξύλον, Ap 18:12 (Diosc.).†
(AS)

G2368.def:
θυμίαμα, -τος, τό
(θυμιάω), [in LXX chiefly for קְטֹרֶת ;]
fragrant stuff for burning, incense: ἡ ὥρα τοῦ θ., Lc 1:10; θυσιαστήριον τοῦ θ. (Êx 30:27, al.), Lc 1:11; pl., Ap 5:8 8:3-4 18:13.†
(AS)

G2369.def:
θυμιατήριον, -ου, τό
(θυμιάω), [in LXX: 2Cr 26:19, Eze.8:11 (קְטֹרֶת), 4Ma.7:11 * ;]
__1. as in cl. (Hdt., iv, 162; Thuc., vi, 46) and LXX, a censer: Hb 9:4 (but see infr., and cf. Westc., in l).
__2. As in Philo., rer. div., § 46, FlJ, Ant., iv, 2, 4, al., the altar of incense: He, l.with (but see supr. and cf. MM, Exp., xv).†
(AS)

G2370.def:
θυμιάω, -ῶ
(θύω), [in LXX (with -άζω) chiefly for קָטַר pi., hi. ;]
to burn incense: Lc 1:9.†
(AS)

G2371.def:
θυμομαέω, -ῶ
(θυμός, μάχομαι),
to fight desperately, have a hot quarrel: with dative of person(s), At 12:20.†
(AS)

G2372.def:
θυμός, -οῦ, ὁ
(θύω), [in LXX most frequently for אַף, also for חֱמָא, חָרוֹן, etc., 30 words in all ;]
passion, hot anger, wrath: Hb 11:27; ὀργὴ καὶ θ., Rm 2:8, cf. Cl 3:8; πικρία κ. θ., Ef 4:31; πλησθῆναι, πλήρης θυμοῦ, Lc 4:28, At 19:28; θ. ἔχειν, Ap 12:12; οἶνος τ. θυμοῦ τ. πορνείας (cf. Jr 51:7), Ap 14:8 18:3 (cf. Ap 17:2); οἶνος τ. θ. τ. θεοῦ, Ap 14:10; τ. ὀργῆς τ. θεοῦ, Ap 16:19 19:15; ὁ θ. τ. θεοῦ, Ap 14:19 15:1, 7 16:1; pl., impulses or outbursts of anger: ἔρις, ζῆλος, θυμοὶ, ἐριθίαι, 2Co 12:20, Gl 5:20 (Cremer, 287, 733).†
SYN.: ὀργή, παροργισμός (AS)

G2373.def:
θυμόω, -ῶ
(θυμός) [in LXX (chiefly in pass.) for חָרָה, אַף חָרָה hith., etc. ;] (no act. in Attic.);
pass. (and mid.),
to be wroth or very angry: Mt 2:16.†
(AS)

G2374.def:
θύρα, -ας, ἡ
[in LXX chiefly for פֶּתַח, also for דַּל, דֶּלֶת, etc. ;]
a door: κλείειν (ἀποκ-) τὴν θ., Mt 6:6, Lc 13:25; pass., Mt 25:10, Lc 11:7, Jo 20:19, 26, At 21:30; ἀνοίγειν, At 5:19; pass., At 16:26-27; κρούειν, At 12:13; διὰ τῆς θ., Jo 10:1-2; πρὸς τὴν θ., Mc 1:33 11:4 (WH om. τήν), At 3:2; τὰ πρὸς τὴν θ., the space by the door, Mc 2:2; πρὸς τῇ θ., Jo 18:16; ἐπὶ τῇ θ, At 5:9; πρὸ τῆς θ., At 12:6; ἐπὶ τῶν θ., At 5:23; ἡ θ. τ. μνημείου, Mt 27:60, Mc 15:46 16:3. Metaphorical, of Christ, ἡ θ. τ. προβάτων, Jo 10:7, 9; of the Kingdom of Heaven, Lc 13:24; of opportunities, θ. πίστεως, At 14:27; θ. μεγάλη, 1Co 16:9; θ. τ. λόγου, Cl 4:3; θ. ἀνεῳγμένη (ἠνεῳγ-), 2Co 2:12, Ap 3:8 4:1; of Christ, ἑστηκὼς ἐπὶ τὴν θ. καὶ κρούων, Ap 3:20; of his second coming, ἐπὶ θύραις εἶναι, Mt 24:33, Mc 13:29; πρὸ θυρῶν ἑστηκέναι, Tg 5:9.†
(AS)

G2375.def:
θυρεός, -οῦ, ὁ
(θύρα), [in LXX for מָגֵן, צִנָּה ;]
__1. in Hom., a door-stone.
__2. In late Gk. (Polyb., Plut.), the scutum, a large oblong shield: θ. τ. πίστεως, Ef 6:16 (cf. Wis.5:20, where ὁσιότης is likened to the ἀσπίς, the clypeus or small round shield of the light-armed soldier).†
(AS)

G2376.def:
θυρίς, -ίδος, ἡ
(dim, of θύρα), [in LXX chiefly for חַלּוֹן ;]
a window: At 20:9, 2Co 11:33.†
(AS)

G2377.def:
θυρωρός, -οῦ, ὁ, ἡ
(θύρα, + οὖρος, a guardian) [in LXX: 4Ki.7:11 (שׁוֹעֵר), Eze.44:11 (פְּקֻדָּה), 2Rs 4:6 4:1 II Et 7:1-28 * ;]
a door-keeper, porter: ὁ, Mc 13:34, Jo 10:3; ἡ, Jo 18:16-17†
(AS)

G2378.def:
θυσία, -ας, ἡ
(θύω) [in LXX chiefly for מִנְחָה, זָבַח ;]
__1. actively, an offering, sacrifice (Hdt., al.)
__2. Objectively, that which is offered, a sacrifice: Mt 9:13 12:7" (LXX), Mc 9:49 (WH, mg.), Ef 5:2, Hb 10:5, 26; pl. (as usually in cl.), Mc 12:33, Lc 13:1, Hb 9:23 10:1, 8, (θ. καὶ προσφοράς); θ. ἀνάγειν, At 7:41; ἀναφέρειν, Hb 7:27; προσφέρειν, At 7:42, Hb 5:1 8:3 (δῶρά τε καὶ θ.) Hb 10:11-12 11:4; δοῦναι, Lc 2:24; pass., Hb 9:9; διὰ τῆς θ. αὐτοῦ, Hb 9:26; ἐσθίειν τὰς θ. (Lv 7:15 ff) 1Co 10:18. Metaphorical, Fp 4:18, Hb 13:16; θ. πνευματικαί, 1Pe 2:5; θ. ζῶσα, Rm 12:1; θ. αἰνέσεως, Hb 13:15; θ. . . . τ. πίστεως, Fp 2:17.†
(AS)

G2379.def:
θυσιαστήριον, -ου, τό
(θυσιάζω, to sacrifice), [in LXX (where the word first appears) very freq., nearly always for מַדְבַּח ;]
an altar:
__(a) generally, Tg 2:21; pl., Rm 11:3 (LXX); metaphorically, Hb 13:10 (see Westc., in l, and esp. his add, note on the history of the word, 455 ff.);
__(b) of the altar of burnt-offering in the Temple, Mt 5:23-24 23:18-20, 35, Lc 11:51, 1Co 9:13 10:18, Hb 7:13, Ap 11:1;
__(with) of the altar of incense in the sanctuary (Êx 30:1, al.), Lc 1:11; symbolically in Heaven, Ap 6:9 8:3 9:13 14:18 16:7 (Cremer, 292).†
(AS)

G2380.def:
θύω
[in LXX chiefly for זָבַח, also for שָׁחַט, etc. ;]
as in c1.;
__1. to offer first fruits to a god.
__2. to sacrifice by slaying a victim, offer sacrifice: At 14:13; with dative of person(s), At 14:18; id. with accusative of thing(s), 1Co 10:20.
__3. to slay, kill: Jo 10:10, At 10:13 11:7; with accusative of thing(s), Lc 15:23, 27 15:30; pass., Mt 22:4; τὸ πάσχα (Êx 12:21), Mc 14:12; pass., Lc 22:7, 1Co 5:7.†
(AS)

G2381.def:
θωμᾶς, -ᾶ, ὁ (Heb.: תָּאוֹם, a twin; cf. δίδυμος),
Thomas the Apostle: Mt 10:3, Mc 3:18, Lc 6:15, Jo 11:16 14:5 20:24-28 21:2, At 1:13.†
(AS)

G2382.def:
θώραξ, -ακσς, ὁ
[in LXX chiefly for שִׁרְיוֹן and cogn. forms ;]
a breastplate: Ap 9:9, 17; θ. τ. δικαιοσύνης, Ef 6:14 (cf. Is 59:17, Wis.5:18-19); θ. πίστεως, 1Ts 5:8.†
(AS)

G2384G.def:
Ἰακώβ, ὁ indecl. (Heb. יַעֲקֹב),
Jacob;
__1. The patriarch: Mt 1:2 8:11, Jo 4:5-6, At 7:8, al; as in Heb. (cf. Nm 23:7, Is 41:8, Sir.23:12, al.), of his descendants, Rm 11:26 (LXX).
__2. The father-in-law of Mary: Mt 1:15-16 (on the form as distinct from that of the next word, see Deiss., BS, 3161)
(AS)

G2384H.def:
Ἰακώβ, ὁ indecl. (Heb. יַעֲקֹב),
Jacob;
__1. The patriarch: Mt 1:2 8:11, Jo 4:5-6, At 7:8, al; as in Heb. (cf. Nm 23:7, Is 41:8, Sir.23:12, al.), of his descendants, Rm 11:26 (LXX).
__2. The father-in-law of Mary: Mt 1:15-16 (on the form as distinct from that of the next word, see Deiss., BS, 3161)
(AS)

G2385G.def:
Ἰάκωβος, -ου, ὁ (Heb., see previous word)
James;
__1. Son of Zebedee: Mt 4:21, Mc 1:19, 29, At 1:13 12:2, al.
__2. Son of Alphæus: Mt 10:3, Mc 2:14, al.; commonly identified with Ἰ. ὁ μικρός, James the little, son of Mary (see: Μαρία, 3; Κλωπᾶς), Mt 27:56, Mc 15:40 16:1 (cf. Jo 19:25).
__3. The Lord's brother (see: ἀδελφός): Mt 13:55, Mc 6:3, At 12:17, al., 1Co 15:7 (probably), Gl 1:19 2:9, 12, Tg 1:1, Ju 1.
__4. The father of the apostle, Ἰούδας Ἰακώβου: Lc 6:16, At 1:13
(AS)

G2385H.def:
Ἰάκωβος, -ου, ὁ (Heb., see previous word)
James;
__1. Son of Zebedee: Mt 4:21, Mc 1:19, 29, At 1:13 12:2, al.
__2. Son of Alphæus: Mt 10:3, Mc 2:14, al.; commonly identified with Ἰ. ὁ μικρός, James the little, son of Mary (see: Μαρία, 3; Κλωπᾶς), Mt 27:56, Mc 15:40 16:1 (cf. Jo 19:25).
__3. The Lord's brother (see: ἀδελφός): Mt 13:55, Mc 6:3, At 12:17, al., 1Co 15:7 (probably), Gl 1:19 2:9, 12, Tg 1:1, Ju 1.
__4. The father of the apostle, Ἰούδας Ἰακώβου: Lc 6:16, At 1:13
(AS)

G2385I.def:
Ἰάκωβος, -ου, ὁ (Heb., see previous word)
James;
__1. Son of Zebedee: Mt 4:21, Mc 1:19, 29, At 1:13 12:2, al.
__2. Son of Alphæus: Mt 10:3, Mc 2:14, al.; commonly identified with Ἰ. ὁ μικρός, James the little, son of Mary (see: Μαρία, 3; Κλωπᾶς), Mt 27:56, Mc 15:40 16:1 (cf. Jo 19:25).
__3. The Lord's brother (see: ἀδελφός): Mt 13:55, Mc 6:3, At 12:17, al., 1Co 15:7 (probably), Gl 1:19 2:9, 12, Tg 1:1, Ju 1.
__4. The father of the apostle, Ἰούδας Ἰακώβου: Lc 6:16, At 1:13
(AS)

G2385J.def:
Ἰάκωβος, -ου, ὁ (Heb., see previous word)
James;
__1. Son of Zebedee: Mt 4:21, Mc 1:19, 29, At 1:13 12:2, al.
__2. Son of Alphæus: Mt 10:3, Mc 2:14, al.; commonly identified with Ἰ. ὁ μικρός, James the little, son of Mary (see: Μαρία, 3; Κλωπᾶς), Mt 27:56, Mc 15:40 16:1 (cf. Jo 19:25).
__3. The Lord's brother (see: ἀδελφός): Mt 13:55, Mc 6:3, At 12:17, al., 1Co 15:7 (probably), Gl 1:19 2:9, 12, Tg 1:1, Ju 1.
__4. The father of the apostle, Ἰούδας Ἰακώβου: Lc 6:16, At 1:13
(AS)

G2386.def:
ἴαμα, -τος, τό
(ἰάομαι), [in LXX for מַרְפֵּא (2Cr 36:16, Ec 10:4, Jr 33:6, etc. ;]
__1. most frequently in cl., a means of healing, remedy (Thuc., al.; Wis.11:4 10:9).
__2. = ἴασις (which see), a healing (Plat.; Jer, l.with): pl., 1Co 12:9 12:28 12:30.†
(AS)

G2390.def:
ἰάομαι, -ῶμαι
[in LXX for רָפָא (Gn 20:17, al.), exc. Is 30:26 61:1 (חָבַשׁ) ;]
to heal: with accusative of person(s), Lc 5:17 6:19 9:2, 11 9:42 14:4 22:51, Jo 4:47, At 9:34 10:38 28:8; pass., Mt 8:8, 13 15:28, Lc 7:7 8:47 17:15, Jo 5:13; id. before ἀπό᾽, Mc 5:29, Lc 6:17; figuratively, of spiritual healing, Mt 13:15, Jo 12:40, At 28:27" (LXX) ; pass., Hb 12:13, Tg 5:16, 1Pe 2:24.†
SYN.: θεραπεύω, q.v (AS)

G2391.def:
Ἰάρετ (Rec. -ρέδ, L, Ἰάρεθ), ὁ (Heb. יֶרֶד, LXX Ἰάρεδ, FlJ, Ἰάρεδος),
Jared (Gn 5:15): Lc 3:37.†
(AS)

G2392.def:
ἴασις, -εως, ἡ
(ἰάομαι), [in LXX chiefly for מַרְפֵּא ;]
a healing, cure: At 4:22, 30; pl., Lc 13:32.†
SYN.: see: θεραπεία, 2; ἴαμα, 2 (AS)

G2393.def:
ἴασπις, -ιδος, ἡ
[in LXX: Êx 28:18 36:38 (Êx 39:11) (יַהֲלֹם), Is 54:12 (כַּדְכֹּד), Eze.28:13 (יָשְׁפֵה, see BDB, Lex., see word)* ;]
jasper, apparently not the modern stone of that name, but a translucent stone (DB, see word): Ap 4:3 21:11, 18-19.†
(AS)

G2394.def:
Ἰάσων, -ονος, ὁ
Jason: At 17:5-7, 9; perhaps the same, Rm 16:21.†
(AS)

G2395.def:
ἰατρός, -οὔ, ὁ
(ἰάομαι), [in LXX for רָפָא ;]
a physician: Mt 9:12, Mc 2:17 5:26, Lc 4:23 5:31 8:43 (om. WH, R, mg.), Cl 4:14 (on the status of physicians, see MM, Exp., xv.).†
(AS)

G2396.def:
ἴδε (Attic ἰδέ; the "later" accentuation is also found in Hom.; Veitch, 215)
__1. prop., 2 aor. imperat. of ὁράω, which see
__2. As interjection, apart from the construction of the sentence, and used where one or many are addressed, see! behold! lo!: Mt 25:20, 22 25:25, Mc 2:24 3:34 11:21 13:1, 21 15:4, 35 16:6, Jo 1:29, 36 1:48 3:26 5:14 7:26 11:3, 36 12:19 16:29 18:21 19:4, 14 19:26-27, Gl 5:2.†
(AS)

G2397.def:
ἰδέα, -ας, ἡ, see: εἰδέα
εἰδέα (Rec. ἰδ-, as in cl.; see Tdf., Pr., 81), -ας, ἡ (εἶδον), [in LXX (seel. ἰδ-): Gn 5:3 (דְּמוּת), Da TH 1:13, 15 (מַרְאֶה), Ep. Jer.63, 2Ma.3:16 * ;]
appearance, look: Mt 28:3.†
(AS)

G2398.def:
ἴδιος, -α, -ον (in Attic usually -ος, -ον),
[in LXX chiefly for of person(s) suff., also for לָהֶם, etc.; (τὰ ἴ.) בֵּיתוֹ ;]
__1. one's own;
__(a) of that which is private and personal (in cl. opposite to κοινός, δημόσιος; cf. infr. 3);
__(b) of property, friends, home, country, etc. (in cl. opposite to ἀλλότριος; in late writers often, like ἑαυτοῦ, with weakened sense, see M, Pr., 87ff.; Deiss., BS, 123f.): Lc 6:41, Jo 1:42 5:43, At 2:6 20:28, 1Co 11:21, Gl 6:5, 2Tm 1:9, Hb 7:27, Ju 6, al.; πράσσειν τὰ ἴ., 1Ts 4:11; κατὰ τὰς ἰ. ἐπιθυμίας, 2Tm 4:3; οἱ ἴδιοι, Jo 1:11 (M, Pr., 90f.; Field, Notes, 84) 13:1, At 4:23, 1Tm 5:8; τὰ ἴδια, one's home (Field, Notes, l.with), Lc 18:28, Jo 1:11 16:32 19:27.
__2. peculiar, distinct, appropriate, proper: τὸ ἴ. σῶμα, 1Co 15:38; ἐν τ. ἰ. τάγματι, 1Co 15:23; εἰς τ. τόπον τ. ἴ., At 1:25; = αὐτοῦ (see Deiss., ut. supr.), Mt 22:5, Jo 1:42 (cf. Wis.10:1).
__3. Adverbially (see supr., 1 (a); and cf. WM, 739:2);
__(a) ἰδίᾳ, severally, separately: 1Co 12:11;
__(b) κατ᾽ ἰδίαν, apart, privately, in private: Mt 14:13, 23 20:17, Mc 4:34 7:33, Lc 10:23, At 23:19, al.
(AS)

G2399.def:
ἰδιώτης, -ου, ὁ
(ἴδιος), [in LXX: Pv 6:8 (no Heb.)* ;]
__1. a pri­vate person, as opposite to the State or an official (βασιλεῖς κ. ἰδιῶται, Pr, l.with; and cf. MM, Exp., xv).
__2. one without professional knowledge, unskilled, uneducated, unlearned: 1Co 14:16 14:23-24 (R, mg., without gifts); ἀγράμματοι κ. ἰ., At 4:13; with dative (= cl. with genitive of thing(s)), λόγῳ, 2Co 11:6.†
(AS)
